en-US.description: One-stop platform to all ViewSonic monitor software.
en-US.longDescription: From effortless setup to seamless updates, the ViewSonic Display Portal takes the hassle out of monitor management by gathering all ViewSonic monitor software and applications in one place. It automatically detects compatible applications the moment you connect your monitor, allowing you to unlock its full potential and facilitating the deployment of essential software, including vDisplay Manager and vSplit, for organizations.
en-US.name: Display Portal

zh-CN.description: 一站式获取所有 ViewSonic 显示器软件的平台。
zh-CN.longDescription: 从轻松安装到无缝更新，ViewSonic Display Portal 将管理显示器的一切繁琐步骤化繁为简，把所有 ViewSonic 显示器软件和应用集中在一处。连接显示器后，它会自动检测兼容的应用，帮助您充分释放显示器的全部潜能，并方便组织部署 vDisplay Manager 和 vSplit 等必备软件。
